CHAPTER.VERS: not by immoral sexual passion, even as the Gentiles who don't know God;
For God called us not for impurity, but in sanctification.
For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so those also that have fallen asleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
For the Lord himself will descend from heaven, with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ will rise first;
then we who are alive, who are left, will together with them be caught up in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
Therefore comfort one another with these words.
